chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Separation and a later breakfast in Las Vegas
summary: He did not protest the separation; she remarried and later tried to entice him, but he went for a lawyer and got the divorce.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So that was one of our movements of separation and I helped her do that, I

said "Go ahead." I didn't put no protest against it. I asked you last, do you think she's happy? Do you think she's happy? She done married again following this divorce. But she came back in order to try to entice me to look over the divorce part, but I didn't. I was at Harris at the time. She was stopping across the street from Harris at the Wagon Wheel Hotel, I think that was it. And I'm over at Harris. And she gets to stay there, she wants me to come over to have breakfast. I went over to have breakfast and there she was decked out in her negligee of "no consent" and I said to myself "not me." And I went looking for a lawyer to get the papers straight. We did, got the divorce and that was it. So later I saw her again when I was with Eddie Fisher at the Sahara, I think it was and I don't think I was -- I had just come from the hospital in Chicago where I had been under a doctor's care and she says -- asked

how I felt and everything, I said I'm doing all right. "How are you?" When a friend of mine passed away here in Los Angeles she came to see this friend from Las Vegas, but I got her a job with Eleanor Powell in Eleanor Powell's show when she came to Las Vegas 'cause I took her there on a show I was doing in Las Vegas. I took her from New York to Las Vegas 'cause I wanted to do this show, open the show called the Carver House, colored on the west side of town, a colored club, colored casino 'cause negroes wasn't allowed in the casino on the east side, you know, in Las Vegas. So I take her out there and while we're out there I get her the job working with Eleanor Powell in I think it was The Dunes. Then I found her colors then really. Understand?
